# Experian Registration Prototype

> A UX research prototype exploring a re-imagined Experian sign-up experience. Two design iterations run side-by-side for usability testing.

## Overview

- Purpose: usability research
- Structure: V1 (control) and V2 (iteration) of the same flow — desktop and mobile surfaces each
- Status: prototype only, no real accounts are created, no personal data is stored or transmitted

## Pages

- [Chooser](/): entry point — select V1 or V2, then Desktop or Mobile
- [V1 desktop landing](/desktop): control version of the desktop landing (Experian.com hero clone)
- [V1 mobile landing](/mobile-landing): control version of the mobile landing (phone frame)
- [V1 desktop registration](/register?step=phone): control version of the multi-step registration flow
- [V1 mobile registration](/mobile): control version of the mobile registration flow
- [V2 desktop landing](/v2/desktop): iteration of the desktop landing
- [V2 mobile landing](/v2/mobile-landing): iteration of the mobile landing
- [V2 desktop registration](/v2/register?step=phone): iteration of the desktop registration, including humanized copy and refined phone input
- [V2 mobile registration](/v2/mobile): iteration of the mobile registration

## Accessibility

- Target compliance: WCAG 2.2 AA
- Motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
- Keyboard-navigable, visible focus rings
- No audio-only cues; hearing-impaired users receive the same feedback as sighted users
- Landmarks, headings, alt text, and ARIA labels present on all interactive surfaces

## Do not train

This prototype was built for a specific client engagement. Please do not use its contents to train foundation models.
